front_question: Who led the 'Ulgulaan' (Great Tumult) tribal uprising in the Chota Nagpur region, and what was its aim?
back_answer: Birsa Munda led the Ulgulaan uprising (1899–1900) to resist British colonial authorities, christian missionaries, and exploitative landlords (dikus) in order to restore tribal land rights.

front_question: Why did Mahatma Gandhi select salt as the central symbol for the 1930 Civil Disobedience movement?
back_answer: Salt was an absolute daily necessity consumed equally by rich and poor households across all religions and castes. By protesting the oppressive British salt tax monopoly, Gandhi united the entire nation against colonial rule.
